title: Razer Huntsman V3 HE Review: Jumping on the Bandwagon
summary: While 8kHz polling is impressive, it’s not exclusive to analog switches (both Hall Effect and optical switches are considered analog, while mechanical switches aren’t)—there are mechanical keyboards that also feature the technology.
